subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 5 updates

question: Should maintainers accept these upgraded CodeQL and Docker Action SHAs for credentialed security and release workflows after verifying their official upstream provenance and a redacted protected-workflow run?
rationale: The patch changes third-party code that executes in workflows with repository and Docker registry credentials; this is an intentional supply-chain trust decision that cannot be resolved from repository syntax checks alone.

options.title: Verify provenance and workflow behavior
options.body: Confirm each immutable SHA matches its stated upstream release and obtain redacted evidence that the protected CodeQL and Docker login paths still complete with the new pins.

options.title: Pause this update
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until an owner can review the action releases and safely exercise the credentialed release path.
